(7) The video concludes with the two women standing together outdoors at sunset, smiling at the camera and making hand gestures. Interspersed are shots of the toddler running around a living room and the women cuddling the child on a black leather sofa.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a deeply personal storytelling vlog where a same-sex couple shares their painful journey through miscarriage and the arduous process of seeking IVF abroad. It transitions from a state of grief to a reflection on the preciousness of life and the resilience of their family.
